description: Evaluation dataset for interview-question generation (chain B). Each case pairs a job description with a hand-written job context (the expected output of chain A) and the topics a good question set should cover. 'expected_topics' keywords drive the deterministic coverage check; 'quality_notes' describe what a strong output looks like at the requested difficulty and are shown to the judge.

cases.job_description: Northwind Payments is hiring a Backend Developer to build and operate Python (FastAPI) services that process card transactions. You will design REST APIs, model data in PostgreSQL, add caching with Redis, write automated tests, and take part in an on-call rotation. Requirements: 3+ years of backend Python, solid SQL, experience with idempotent APIs and background job queues, and clear written communication.
cases.quality_notes: Medium: applied scenarios from payment backend work (e.g. making a charge endpoint safe to retry, choosing an index for a slow query). Expected answers should mention idempotency keys, transactions, cache invalidation, or retries where relevant.

cases.job_description: Lumen Health seeks a Machine Learning Engineer to productionise risk models used by clinicians. You will build training and evaluation pipelines, deploy models behind low-latency APIs, monitor data and concept drift, and work with clinicians to communicate model limitations. Experience with model evaluation under class imbalance, feature stores, and responsible AI practices in regulated settings is essential.
cases.quality_notes: Hard: ambiguous, high-stakes scenarios with trade-offs (e.g. a drift alert on a clinical model with delayed labels; choosing a decision threshold when false negatives are costly). Expected answers should reason about trade-offs, failure modes, and validation, not definitions.

cases.job_description: Greenleaf Retail is looking for a junior Data Analyst to build weekly sales dashboards, write SQL queries against our data warehouse, and answer ad-hoc questions from store managers. You should understand basic statistics (averages, medians, percentages), be comfortable with spreadsheets, and explain numbers clearly to non-technical colleagues.
cases.quality_notes: Easy: single-concept fundamentals suitable for a junior (e.g. difference between INNER and LEFT JOIN; when to use median over mean). No multi-part scenarios. Expected answers should be correct definitions with a simple example.

cases.job_description: Harbor Logistics needs a Financial Analyst in its FP&A team. You will own the monthly forecast for two business units, explain budget-versus-actual variances to operations managers, build driver-based models in Excel, and support pricing decisions. We value accuracy, sound assumptions, and the ability to tell a clear story with numbers.
cases.quality_notes: Medium: applied FP&A situations (e.g. a unit is 12% over budget mid-year; building a driver-based forecast for shipping volume). Expected answers should separate price/volume/mix effects or name concrete drivers.

cases.job_description: Brightpath Software is hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to run end-to-end hiring for engineering roles. You will partner with hiring managers, design structured interview processes, source candidates, manage our applicant tracking system, and track metrics such as time-to-hire and offer acceptance. A commitment to fair and inclusive hiring is essential.
cases.quality_notes: Medium: realistic recruiting scenarios (e.g. a hiring manager wants to skip the structured interview; time-to-hire doubled this quarter). Expected answers should reference structured, evidence-based, and fair practices.

cases.job_description: Cobalt Cloud, a B2B SaaS company, seeks a senior Product Manager for its billing platform. You will set strategy and the roadmap, prioritise between enterprise customer requests and platform reliability, define success metrics, and align engineering, sales, and finance. Experience with pricing changes and making decisions with incomplete data is expected.
cases.quality_notes: Hard: multi-stakeholder, ambiguous scenarios (e.g. the largest customer demands a feature while reliability incidents rise; a pricing change with limited data). Expected answers should weigh trade-offs, name metrics and guardrails, and plan how to align stakeholders.

cases.job_description: Riverside Arts Council is hiring an entry-level Public Relations Specialist to write press releases, maintain relationships with local journalists, manage our social media calendar, and prepare simple reports on media coverage.
cases.quality_notes: Easy: entry-level fundamentals (e.g. what makes a press release newsworthy; how you would introduce yourself to a local journalist). Expected answers should be correct, concrete, and simple.

cases.job_description: Atlas Media is hiring a Platform Engineer to run our Kubernetes platform across two cloud regions. You will own CI/CD pipelines, define SLOs and alerting, lead incident response, manage infrastructure as code with Terraform, and control cloud costs. Experience with multi-region failover and blameless post-incident reviews is required.
cases.quality_notes: Hard: senior scenarios with constraints and trade-offs (e.g. a region fails during a deploy; alerts are noisy and the error budget is burnt). Expected answers should cover failure modes, rollback, SLO trade-offs, and communication.
